original_description:
SSHOW is a design tool where one canvas holds your layout, its motion, and the presentation you give from it. Connect this plugin and your assistant works inside the project you already have open in a SSHOW editor: it reads the scenes and objects, adds or changes text, shapes, images, tables and keyframes, and takes a screenshot to check its own work.

Edits happen in the project on your screen, so you watch each change land. A batch of edits arrives as a single undo step, and the assistant can undo or redo it for you. With no editor open, the assistant can still read the last saved version of your projects, but it cannot change them.

The assistant can also run the presentation from your editor: start it, move through scenes and stops, and try the interactions you built. Share live with viewers is on by default in Play Settings, so anyone who has the project's play link open follows along on their own device. Turn it off to rehearse on your own.

You need a SSHOW account and a project open at s.show or in the desktop app. You sign in once when you connect, and you can end the connection at any time from your profile.
